components.css: .ds-journal-entry { padding-block: 0.625rem; } .ds-entry-title-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.85rem; min-width: 0; } .ds-entry-title { min-width: 0; margin: 0; color: #414141; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.45; font-family: var(--font-family-journal); } .ds-entry-leader { min-width: 1.5rem; flex: 1; border-bottom: 1px dotted #d4d4d4; transform: translateY(-0.18rem); } .ds-entry-date { flex: 0 0 auto; color: #737373; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; font-family: var(--font-family-journal); } .ds-story-link { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-story-link:hover, .ds-story-link:focus-visible { color: #111111; text-decoration: underline; } .ds-entry-excerpt { max-width: 68ch; margin: 0.2rem 0 0; color: #737373; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.55; font-family: var(--font-family-journal); }

components.name: Ghost Button

narrative.overview: Edge Journal is a single-column, card-free publication surface. It borrows the grammar of a printed index: title and date sit on a shared baseline separated by a dotted leader, no container chrome wraps entries, and whitespace replaces decoration. The administrator inherits the same grammar — filters, lists, and forms share the same type scale, leader lines, and column width.
keyCharacteristics: Card-free index — bare rows separated by vertical rhythm, no containers
Dotted leaders over borders for structural separation
Graphite on paper — chromatic color reserved for semantic states
Square controls — near-zero border radius everywhere
Immediate response — 44px touch targets, pointer-down feedback, and interruptible visit loading
Forgiving operations — delete is reversible through an inline Undo action
